description:
Reads MathML, LaTeX, and UnicodeMath aloud in natural Greek, following the dictation
conventions used in Greek schools and universities.
Uses conservative semantic interpretation, terminology profiles, statistics, vector calculus,
quantum notation, SI units, fractions, powers, integrals, derivatives, and matrices.
Includes interactive navigation to explore complex expressions part by part,
three verbosity levels, configurable pronunciations and matrix reading, unsaved speech previews,
and voice download options for OneCore and Vocalizer Expressive.
changelog: Version 2.5.7: on first install and after every update, automatically applies the NVDA settings Greek math reading depends on (Word UI Automation, automatic language switching, Word native math off), so equations are read for new users without pressing Repair.
